title: [CD][CUDA] Stable Diffusion Cannot Be Run Due to CUDNN Errors
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

During testing, @Aidyn-A  noticed that our latest available ARM binary (e.g. cu130) cannot run stable diffusion on `ubuntu:24.04`. 

Steps to reproduce: 
apt update && apt install python3 python3-pip   
~~pip3 install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130~~ Thanks @malfet for pointing out the mistake! 

pip3 install --pre torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu130


Run mini stable diffusion code below: 

pip install diffusers transformers

`sd.py` below: 

```python
import torch
from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline, DPMSolverMultistepScheduler

model_id = "stabilityai/stable-diffusion-2-1"

# Use the DPMSolverMultistepScheduler (DPM-Solver++) scheduler here instead
pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(model_id, torch_dtype=torch.float16)      
pipe.scheduler = DPMSolverMultistepScheduler.from_config(pipe.scheduler.config)
pipe = pipe.to("cuda")

prompt = "a photo of an astronaut riding a horse on mars"
import time
start = time.time()
for i in range(10):
  image = pipe(prompt).images[0]
print("Time taken: ", time.time() - start)

image.save("astronaut_rides_horse.png")
```

```
python3 sd.py 

Error snippet: 

  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/transformers/integrations/sdpa_attention.py", line 96, in sdpa_attention_forward
    attn_output = torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention(
                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
RuntimeError: cuDNN Frontend error: [cudnn_frontend] Error: No valid execution plans built.
```

### Versions

nightly arm cu13 binary. 


We root-caused it to missing PRELOAD of `libnvrtc-builtinso.so.*`. See: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/167586 

As @Aidyn-A  found export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/nvidia/cu13/lib was a workaround and I further confirmed that if we move libnvrtc-builtinso.so.* to /tmp and 
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp would also be a good workaround, clearly showing that sth about libnvrtc-builtin PRELOAD was gone. Then I noticed a recent change: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/167046
